description: An ARMMOHO on the metal patch, spawned as a 90 % nanoframe with an ARMACK repairing it. The applier creates the unit whole and then writes its build fraction, so Create, SetSpeed with its metal and Activate run in the spawn's own tick, and the extractor turns; the repair adds no COB event (the recorded trace has none after the spawn's). COB L2 fixture (research/notes/ingame-wiki-cob-plan.md): one unit type traced with tagpu_cobtrace.on=<type> and one posedump, on the generated map tools/resource_fixture.py installs (RS mixed: SurfaceMetal 20, a 223-metal patch at cells 22..24, the vent at cell 40,24). Run with tools/cobtrace_fixtures.py.
